text: In Lean 4, the 'rw [h]' tactic replaces the left-hand side of h with the right in the goal. What is 'rw [← h]'?
choices: introduces h as a new hypothesis
closes the goal if h is exact
explanation: rw [← h] rewrites right-to-left: it replaces the RHS of h with the LHS in the goal. The ← reverses the direction of the rewrite.
